---
subtitle: Mandatory assignment 2
---

```{r}
#| label: plot-quality-criteria-overview
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(nanoparquet)

results <- bind_rows(
  read_parquet("../submissions/ma-1-evaluation_results.parquet") |>
    mutate(assignment = "MA 1"),
  read_parquet("../submissions/ma-2-evaluation_results.parquet") |>
    mutate(assignment = "MA 2")
)

# The evaluation criteria by category, in the order of the evaluation
criteria_by_category <- list(
  "Code Quality" = c(
    "style_guide_followed",
    "pipe_used_consistently",
    "no_dead_code",
    "dry_principle_followed",
    "meaningful_variable_names",
    "no_magic_numbers",
    "consistent_naming_convention",
    "logical_code_organization",
    "no_debug_output"
  ),
  "Reproducibility" = c(
    "no_absolute_paths",
    "no_setwd_calls",
    "packages_loaded_at_top",
    "no_unused_packages",
    "seed_set_explicitly",
    "seed_set_appropriately",
    "no_implicit_workspace",
    "chunks_execute_in_order"
  ),
  "Communication" = c(
    "figures_have_captions",
    "axes_are_labeled",
    "tables_properly_formatted",
    "tables_have_captions",
    "numeric_columns_formatted",
    "prose_explains_choices",
    "findings_discussed",
    "logical_section_structure",
    "cross_references_used",
    "data_loaded_once",
    "vectorized_operations"
  ),
  "Writing" = c(
    "no_spelling_errors",
    "no_grammatical_errors",
    "no_punctuation_errors",
    "consistent_tense",
    "no_informal_language",
    "claims_are_cited",
    "citations_formatted_consistently",
    "references_section_present",
    "references_complete",
    "no_uncited_references",
    "doi_or_url_provided",
    "no_undefined_acronyms",
    "no_undefined_notation",
    "sentences_are_concise",
    "no_redundant_phrases",
    "precise_quantitative_language",
    "headings_are_informative",
    "consistent_formatting",
    "numbers_formatted_in_prose"
  ),
  "AI Polish" = c(
    "no_ai_filler_phrases",
    "no_overclaiming",
    "no_list_overuse",
    "no_padding",
    "voice_is_consistent",
    "numbers_consistent",
    "terminology_consistent",
    "narrative_matches_output",
    "all_outputs_discussed",
    "no_placeholder_text",
    "no_broken_references",
    "code_chunk_labels_meaningful",
    "chunk_options_appropriate",
    "no_code_in_prose"
  )
)

category_colors <- c(
  "Code Quality" = "#2166AC",
  "Reproducibility" = "#4DAC26",
  "Communication" = "#E08214",
  "Writing" = "#8073AC",
  "AI Polish" = "#D6604D"
)
category_order <- names(criteria_by_category)

criteria_meta <- tibble(
  category = category_order,
  criterion = criteria_by_category
) |>
  unnest(criterion) |>
  mutate(
    color = unname(category_colors[category]),
    criterion_label = criterion |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_sentence()
  )

criterion_order <- results |>
  select(all_of(criteria_meta$criterion)) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "pass_rate") |>
  left_join(criteria_meta, by = "criterion") |>
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = category_order)) |>
  arrange(category, pass_rate) |>
  pull(criterion_label)

plot_data <- results |>
  group_by(assignment) |>
  mutate(submission = paste0("S", row_number())) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(assignment, submission, all_of(criteria_meta$criterion)) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(assignment, submission), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "value") |>
  left_join(criteria_meta, by = "criterion") |>
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = category_order),
    criterion_label = factor(criterion_label, levels = criterion_order)
  )

# One colour per y-axis label, in the order of the factor levels (bottom to
# top). Vectorized colours in element_text() work but make ggplot2 warn that
# they are not officially supported: the only warning that warning: false hides.
label_colors <- tibble(criterion_label = criterion_order) |>
  left_join(criteria_meta, by = "criterion_label") |>
  pull(color)

n_per_assignment <- results |>
  count(assignment) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(assignment, ": n = ", n)) |>
  pull(label) |>
  paste(collapse = " · ")

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = submission, y = criterion_label, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~assignment, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#FFFFFF", "FALSE" = "#F4A582"),
    na.value = "#F0F0F0"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Assignment quality criteria — cohort overview",
    subtitle = "Criteria grouped by category, ordered by pass rate within group. Orange = criterion not met.",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste("Based on LLM-assisted evaluation ·", n_per_assignment)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey50",
      margin = margin(b = 12)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey60", hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = label_colors),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )


```
